question: All codes used to develop the PoC
answer: manifest.json; src/lib/banks.js; src/lib/detect.js; src/lib/storage.js; src/background/service-worker.js; src/content/content.js; src/content/content.css; src/popup/popup.html; src/popup/popup.js; src/popup/popup.css; src/warning/warning.html; src/warning/warning.js; src/warning/warning.css; src/options/options.html; src/options/options.js; src/options/options.css; src/ui/tokens.css; src/ui/shared.css; icons/; demo/test-links.html
how_to_use_in_the_paper: The PoC is a Manifest V3 browser extension written in JavaScript HTML and CSS. Detection runs on the device. There is no backend server.

question: Database for storing reported phishing links
answer: There is no remote database of reported phishing links. The PoC stores data locally with chrome.storage.local (settings and recent checks) and chrome.storage.session (temporary Continue anyway allow-list). Official domains live in src/lib/banks.js.
how_to_use_in_the_paper: Do not describe MySQL Firebase or a crowd-report database. Write that NairaShield uses a local official-domain allowlist plus heuristic scoring.

question: Sample count Legitimate Nigerian domain
how_to_use_in_the_paper: 55 unique official Nigerian bank fintech and regulator domains from the allowlist in src/lib/banks.js. The full evaluation also included 20 other legitimate control sites so total legitimate URLs tested = 75.

question: Sample count localized phishing scams
how_to_use_in_the_paper: 45 constructed localized phishing-style URLs: typosquats brand+risky TLD fake BVN/KYC/login paths and HTTP impersonation. See demo/evaluation-results.csv.

question: True positive count: number of successfully flagged phishing scams
how_to_use_in_the_paper: 44 of 45 phishing URLs were flagged as danger or caution.

question: False Negative count: number of phishing scams that bypassed the check
how_to_use_in_the_paper: 1 phishing URL was not flagged: https://xn--gtbnk-3ve.com/ (punycode lookalike).

question: True Negatives: number of safely passed legitimate addresses
how_to_use_in_the_paper: All 75 legitimate URLs were passed (55 official Nigerian domains + 20 other legitimate sites). No official allowlist domain was blocked.

question: False positives: number of false alerts on legitimate addresses
how_to_use_in_the_paper: No legitimate address in the evaluation set produced a false alert.
